request.prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create ONE square 1024x1024 image. The first 4 attached images are STYLE references only (frame, flat shapes, palette); do not copy their birds. Save the generated PNG into the current working directory as out.png and reply with only its path. This is variation 3; vary the composition a little. Image brief:
Flat geometric bird icon in a Mondrian / De Stijl spirit, matching the reference images. A thick navy square frame (#0B0F24) around an ivory field (#FAF6EE). Right-facing head-and-upper-breast portrait. The bird is a bold navy silhouette with a few flat color fields; it may run off the bottom and left edges of the frame only, and leaves clear ivory space between the bill tip, crest and the frame. One simple round eye. Use only these colors: navy #0B0F24, ivory #FAF6EE, chrome yellow #F7B902, vermilion #C7301C, Klein blue #002FA7, slate #5E6178. Three or four colors in total. No gradients, shading, texture, outlines of feather detail, scenery, text or labels. Simple shapes that stay readable at 32 pixels.

Species: Osprey (Pandion haliaetus). Identifying features to show: white crown; dark stripe from the eye back to the nape; hooked dark bill; white throat and breast; dark brown-black back; yellow eye; at most a small, shaggy crest at the nape. Proportions measured from a photo: bill to head = 0.3. Do not draw: a tall spiky crest.
Art director's change for this version: Only a small, shaggy crest at the back of the head. A dark stripe from the eye back to the nape, white crown and underparts, dark back.
